title: 第10章 大买特买
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
主岛和老家城市生活没法比，但跟一家子现在驻扎的小岛屿比起来，说是进城都不为过。

    街道也就百米左右。

    道路两边同样是两排平房。

    卫生院，邮局，门市部，粮油店，公家单位的办事处都挨着呢。

    本地渔民也多住在这一片，直接沿着海边排成一溜。

    家家户户修得比较简陋，但每家每户门口都有大水缸子和凉棚。

    棚子下都挂着咸鱼，海鳗，各种串起来的风干螺肉。

    婆媳俩见着眼生的海货就得问一问是什么，再唏嘘几句真是开了眼。

    大人步伐大，加上沉浸于参观难免走得快些。

    苗苗哒哒哒的绕到大人面前，问：“爸，这里有拍花子吗？”

    魏建业都笑了。

    这地儿兵都比岛民多，哪来的拍花子。

    不过女儿警惕性高是好事，他还是笃定地点点头，“有的。”

    苗苗就一脸操心地说：“那你们还不看好小孩子！”

    她牵着芽芽送到蔡老太手里头。

    奶奶最强，所以看护最弱的妹妹。

    苗苗又叫亲妈牵着弟弟，自己走过去拉着魏建业的手，捂着心窝子老气横秋的叹了口气，

    她是大孩子了，就自己看管自己吧！

    魏建业哪知道闺女的分配标准，只当人跟他亲呢，高高兴兴地说：“咱到服务社买糖去。”

    他也想叫亲妈和媳妇高兴，又指着道路尽头的边防营区大门追加了一句，“营区里家属区里人多些，而且东西也多。”

    婆媳俩确实爱听这话，但更重要的是两个小时后交通船就要返航，也得赶紧去干正经事。

    一家子不再溜达，加快步伐往边防营区去。

    魏建业转到气象局之前就是边防营区的人。

    饶是如今工作内容变了，但还得承担日常小岛基础巡视啥的，来这就相当于回老家了。

    营区有大门有围墙，但仍能瞧见渔民走来走去。

    魏建业告诉家里人，“平日里放电影的时候，本地渔民都会来跟着一块看呢，要是船坏了或者出海捕鱼受了伤也会上营区来求助。”
content_en:
The main island is incomparable to the city life in my hometown, but compared to the small island where my family is currently stationed, it's not an exaggeration to say it's like living in a city.

The street is only about 100 meters.

There are also two rows of bungalows on both sides of the road.

Health centers, post offices, sales departments, grain and oil stores, and public sector offices are all next to each other.

Most local fishermen also live in this area, lining up directly along the seaside.

Every house is relatively simple, but there is a large water tank and a pergola at the door of every house.

There are salted fish, conger eels, and various skewered dried snails hanging under the shed.

When the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law saw the strange seafood, they had to ask what it was, and they sighed a few words, which was really eye-opening.

Adults have long steps and are immersed in sightseeing, so they inevitably walk faster.

Miaomiao walked around in front of the adult and asked, "Dad, are there any flowers here?"

Wei Jianye laughed.

There are more soldiers here than the islanders, so where can we take pictures?

However, it was a good thing that his daughter was more vigilant, so he nodded firmly, "Yes."

Miaomiao said with a worried look on her face: "Then you still don't take good care of the children!"

She took Yaya and sent it to Mrs. Cai.

Grandma is the strongest, so she takes care of the weakest sister.

Miao Miao asked her mother to hold her brother again, walked over and took Wei Jianye's hand, covering her heart and sighing old-fashionedly,

She is a big child, so she can take care of herself!

Wei Jianye didn't know the distribution standard of his daughter. He only treated him as a human being and said happily: "Let's go to the service center to buy candies."

He also wanted to make his mother and daughter-in-law happy, so he pointed to the gate of the border defense camp at the end of the road and added, "There are more people in the family area of the camp, and there are more things."

The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law really like to hear this, but more importantly, the transport ship will return in two hours, and they have to get down to business quickly.

The family stopped strolling and walked quickly towards the border camp.

Wei Jianye was a member of the border defense camp before he was transferred to the Meteorological Bureau.

Although the work content has changed now, I still have to undertake daily basic inspections of the island. Coming here is equivalent to returning to my hometown.

The camp has gates and walls, but you can still see fishermen walking around.

Wei Jianye told his family, “When movies are shown on weekdays, local fishermen will come and watch them together. If their boat breaks down or they are injured while fishing, they will come to the camp for help.”
